reason: I'm not putting my card into some website I never heard of for an app that isn't even in the App Store. And honestly I'd do the trick twice for the family and then forget it's on my phone.
objection: Paying by card on an unknown site for an app installed from the browser feels sketchy, and I'll get bored after a couple of uses anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it were on the App Store or Google Play so I could pay through them, and the free tricks actually got a big reaction from my family.
